### Tools

*   [VPN Bypass](https://openappscout.com/apps/vpn-bypass/) - A Mac menu bar app that routes chosen sites around your VPN, or only those through it. ([Source (⭐127)](https://github.com/GeiserX/VPN-Bypass))

### Games

*   [Patzer](https://openappscout.com/apps/patzer/) - Self-hosted Chess.com alternative with game review, play vs Stockfish and an AI coach on your own model. ([Source (⭐42)](https://github.com/SikamikanikoBG/patzer))

  • Amical - Local-first AI dictation for Mac and Windows that formats your speech for the app you're typing in. (Source (⭐1.6k))
  • AnythingLLM - Chat with your own documents and run AI agents with local or cloud models, on desktop or Docker. (Source (⭐67k))
  • Baserow - A self-hostable no-code database with spreadsheet tables, forms, kanban views and apps. (Source (⭐6.2k))
  • Eigent - A desktop app that splits your work across a team of AI agents running in parallel, with any model. (Source (⭐16k))
  • Excalidraw - A hand-drawn-style whiteboard for diagrams and sketches, with encrypted live collaboration. (Source (⭐134k))
  • Flow Launcher - A fast keyboard launcher for Windows to find apps and files, run commands and add plugins. (Source (⭐16k))
  • FluidVoice - Fast on-device dictation for Mac, with optional AI cleanup of the text. (Source (⭐12k))
  • Formbricks - Run link, website, in-app and email surveys on your own server or in Formbricks Cloud. (Source (⭐13k))
  • FreeFlow - Free Mac dictation that cleans up your speech with Groq or any OpenAI-compatible provider you choose. (Source (⭐3k))
  • Grist - A spreadsheet with database structure and Python formulas, self-hosted or as a desktop app. (Source (⭐12k))
  • Handy - Offline dictation for Windows, Mac and Linux that types what you say into any app. (Source (⭐35k))
  • HeyForm - Build conversational forms, surveys, quizzes and polls on your own server or HeyForm's hosted service. (Source (⭐9k))
  • It's a Plan - A self-hosted issue tracker where AI agents take issues on the same board as your team. (Source (⭐2k))
  • Jan - Chat with open AI models offline on Mac, Windows and Linux, a ChatGPT alternative. (Source (⭐45k))
  • Kanboard - A minimal self-hosted Kanban board with WIP limits, subtasks and automatic actions. (Source (⭐9.9k))
  • Kaneo - Lightweight project management with boards, lists, calendars and Gantt charts, self-hosted or cloud. (Source (⭐9.6k))
  • Khoj - A personal AI that answers from the web and your own documents, self-hosted or in the cloud. (Source (⭐38k))
  • Kinetic Life OS - Projects, daily tasks, health, workouts and ideas in one local-first web app, with no account. (Source (⭐0))
  • Leantime - Self-hosted project management for non-project-managers, with tasks, goals, timesheets and docs. (Source (⭐12k))
  • Libre WebUI - Chat with local Ollama or cloud models and your own documents in a self-hosted AI workspace. (Source (⭐98))
  • LibreChat - A self-hosted ChatGPT-style chat for your team that works with many AI model providers. (Source (⭐46k))
  • LimeSurvey - Self-hosted surveys with branching logic, 80+ languages, statistics and an API. (Source (⭐3.8k))
  • Lotti - A private logbook for tasks, time, journaling, habits and health, synced with end-to-end encryption. (Source (⭐1.2k))
  • Minutes - Meeting and voice-memo recorder that transcribes on your computer and saves Markdown your AI tools can search. (Source (⭐1.6k))
  • Morphic - Self-hosted AI search engine that answers with cited sources, using the model and search provider you choose. (Source (⭐9.2k))
  • Open Cowork - Desktop AI agent for Windows and Mac that works on your files and runs its commands in a safe local VM. (Source (⭐2.2k))
  • OpenLess - Voice typing for Windows, Mac, Linux and Android that turns speech into polished text in the style you choose. (Source (⭐4k))
  • OpenMausBot - Desktop chat app where each contact is an AI bot with its own computer, using your local Claude or Codex. (Source (⭐5.6k))
  • OpenProject - Self-hosted project management with agile boards, Gantt charts and time tracking, a Jira alternative. (Source (⭐16k))
  • OpenWhispr - Voice dictation and meeting transcription for Mac, Windows and Linux, on-device or with your own cloud key. (Source (⭐9.6k))
  • OpenWork - Desktop app for Mac, Windows and Linux where AI agents work on your files with the model you choose. (Source (⭐24k))
  • OpenWorker - Desktop AI coworker for Mac and Windows that finishes reports and documents and asks before acting. (Source (⭐19k))
  • OpnForm - No-code form builder with unlimited forms, logic and embeds, self-hosted or cloud, a Typeform alternative. (Source (⭐3.9k))
  • Plane - Self-hostable project management and issue tracker, a Linear and Jira alternative. (Source (⭐61k))
  • Presenton - AI presentation maker that exports editable PowerPoint files, self-hosted or desktop, with any model. (Source (⭐11k))
  • Rakazo - Self-hosted AI teammates with their own memory and computer, used from web, desktop or mobile. (Source (⭐5.8k))
  • Rome - A self-hosted AI agent that turns repeated work into small scheduled apps you reach from chat. (Source (⭐867))
  • Sol - A Mac launcher with app search, window management, clipboard history and many built-in utilities. (Source (⭐3.2k))
  • SpeakoFlow - Offline voice dictation for Windows, macOS and Linux, with a voice assistant that drafts replies. (Source (⭐363))
  • Taiga - Agile project management with Scrum backlogs, sprints and Kanban boards, self-hosted or hosted. (Source (⭐859))
  • Teable - A self-hosted Airtable-style spreadsheet database with views, formulas, automations and an API. (Source (⭐22k))
  • Vane - A self-hosted Perplexity-style AI search engine that answers with sources, using local or cloud models. (Source (⭐38k))
  • Vicinae - A Raycast-style keyboard launcher for Linux, macOS and Windows that runs many Raycast extensions. (Source (⭐10k))
  • Vikunja - A self-hosted to-do and project app with list, Kanban and Gantt views and import from Todoist and Trello. (Source (⭐5.7k))
  • VoiceInk - Mac dictation that transcribes on your device and adapts the text to the app you are typing in. (Source (⭐6.9k))
  • Voicetypr - Offline dictation for Windows and Mac that types at your cursor, with optional AI formatting. (Source (⭐738))
  • Voquill - Voice typing for Mac, Windows and Linux with AI cleanup and a personal glossary for names and terms. (Source (⭐1k))
  • WeKan - A self-hosted, real-time Kanban board for teams, with swimlanes and import from Trello. (Source (⭐21k))
  • Wox - A keyboard launcher for Windows, macOS and Linux with app and file search and a plugin store. (Source (⭐28k))

Tools

  • IOTA Watch - A read-only web dashboard for activity and rewards on IOTA Train at Home, xCoin XID and Quantus. (Source (⭐1))
  • ItsPaint - Paint and mark up screenshots on your Mac, fully offline. (Source (⭐50))

Developer Tools

  • AgentConnect - Self-hosted AI agents that work alongside your team in Slack, Discord, GitHub and Linear. (Source (⭐1.5k))
  • Appsmith - Build admin panels, dashboards and internal tools on your databases and APIs, self-hosted. (Source (⭐41k))
  • Appwrite - A ready-made backend for web and mobile apps — auth, database, storage and functions — self-hosted or cloud. (Source (⭐58k))
  • Budibase - Build internal apps, automations and AI agents on your own databases, self-hosted or in the cloud. (Source (⭐28k))
  • Centaur - A shared AI agent for your team in Slack that works in its own sandbox with a shell, git and your tools. (Source (⭐1.4k))
  • Cline - An AI coding agent for VS Code, the terminal and desktop that asks before every edit and command. (Source (⭐71k))
  • Dyad - Build apps from prompts on your own computer with your own AI keys or local models, no sign-up. (Source (⭐22k))
  • Emdash - Run several AI coding agents side by side and review their diffs and pull requests in one app. (Source (⭐6.1k))
  • Goose - An AI agent for Mac, Windows and Linux that codes, researches and automates tasks with any model. (Source (⭐55k))
  • Keycloak - Add single sign-on, social login and user management to your apps with a self-hosted server. (Source (⭐37k))
  • Kilo Code - An AI coding agent and autocomplete for VS Code, JetBrains and the terminal, with any model. (Source (⭐28k))
  • NextCoWork - Desktop app for Mac, Windows and Linux that runs AI coding agents side by side and asks before each action. (Source (⭐640))
  • Oh My Android - Mac control panel for the Android Emulator and phones, with an MCP server for AI coding agents. (Source (⭐60))
  • OpenCode - AI coding agent for the terminal that works with any model, including local ones, plus a desktop app. (Source (⭐217k))
  • opendray - Self-hosted gateway that keeps AI coding agents running on your server so you can resume from browser, phone or chat. (Source (⭐69))
  • OpenHands - Self-hosted control center for AI coding agents, with tasks triggered on a schedule or from Slack and GitHub. (Source (⭐92k))
  • OpenTag - Slack teammate that runs your AI coding agent on your own computer and replies in the thread. (Source (⭐1.4k))
  • Penpot - Browser-based design and prototyping tool for product teams, a self-hostable Figma alternative. (Source (⭐61k))
  • PocketBase - Backend in one file with a database, realtime, auth, file storage and an admin dashboard. (Source (⭐61k))
  • Qwen Code - AI coding agent for the terminal from the Qwen team, a Claude Code alternative that works with many models. (Source (⭐29k))
  • Supabase - A Firebase-style app backend with a Postgres database, auth, APIs, realtime and storage, hosted or self-hosted. (Source (⭐112k))
  • ToolJet - A low-code builder for internal tools, admin panels and dashboards, self-hosted or in the cloud. (Source (⭐41k))
  • twinny - An AI coding assistant for VS Code that runs on your own model server instead of GitHub Copilot. (Source (⭐3.7k))
  • Zed - A fast AI code editor for macOS, Windows and Linux with agents, edit prediction and live collaboration. (Source (⭐92k))

Business

  • aiFetchly - A desktop AI agent for lead generation, outreach and scheduled business workflows on Windows, macOS and Linux. (Source (⭐3))
  • Chatwoot - One support inbox for live chat, email, WhatsApp and social channels, with a help centre. (Source (⭐38k))
  • Frappe Helpdesk - A customer service and ticketing app from the makers of ERPNext, self-hosted or on Frappe Cloud. (Source (⭐3.4k))
  • FreeScout - A self-hosted help desk and shared inbox with unlimited agents, a free Zendesk and Help Scout alternative. (Source (⭐4.6k))
  • InvoiceFlowAI - Collect emailed invoices, read them with OCR and export an Excel expense summary, on Windows and Mac. (Source (⭐522))
  • Matomo - Full-featured web and app analytics on your own server, a Google Analytics alternative. (Source (⭐22k))
  • OpenPanel - Self-hostable web and product analytics, a Mixpanel and Google Analytics alternative with funnels and replay. (Source (⭐7.2k))
  • Plausible Analytics - Cookie-free, privacy-first website analytics on one dashboard, a self-hostable Google Analytics alternative. (Source (⭐30k))
  • Rybbit - Cookie-free web and product analytics with funnels and session replays, self-hosted or in the cloud. (Source (⭐13k))
  • Umami - Cookie-free, privacy-first website analytics you can self-host or use on Umami Cloud. (Source (⭐40k))
  • Zammad - A helpdesk that puts customer email, chat, phone and social messages into one ticket system. (Source (⭐6k))

Media

  • Buzz - Offline transcription and translation of audio and video with Whisper, on Mac, Windows and Linux. (Source (⭐22k))
  • ComfyUI - Generate images, video and audio with open AI models on your own GPU by wiring nodes into a workflow. (Source (⭐139k))
  • Invoke - Generate and edit images on your own GPU with Stable Diffusion, Flux and other open models. (Source (⭐29k))
  • SwarmUI - A beginner-friendly web app for generating AI images and video locally, built on ComfyUI. (Source (⭐4.7k))
  • Vibe - Offline transcription for audio and video on Mac, Windows and Linux, with speaker labels and subtitles. (Source (⭐7.8k))
  • VoiceStudio - A local voice studio for voice cloning, video dubbing, dictation and audiobooks on Mac, Windows and Linux. (Source (⭐87k))

items.content_text:
### Productivity

*   [AI Novel Writer](https://openappscout.com/apps/ai-novel-writer/) - A desktop workspace for novelists that keeps characters, outlines, chapters and AI drafting in one project. ([Source (⭐1.6k)](https://github.com/EthanYoQ/AI-Novel-Writer))
*   [anarlog](https://openappscout.com/apps/anarlog/) - Local-first AI meeting notes for Mac, Windows and Linux, with no bot joining your call. ([Source (⭐9.5k)](https://github.com/fastrepl/anarlog))
*   [AppFlowy](https://openappscout.com/apps/appflowy/) - A Notion-style workspace for pages, wikis and databases, with your data on your own devices or server. ([Source (⭐78k)](https://github.com/AppFlowy-IO/AppFlowy))
*   [Authier](https://openappscout.com/apps/authier/) - An experimental password manager with encrypted sync, 2FA codes, browser extensions and mobile apps. ([Source (⭐22)](https://github.com/authier-pm/authier))
*   [Butterfly](https://openappscout.com/apps/butterfly/) - Take notes and sketch on an infinite canvas with ink, text, shapes and images, with WebDAV sync. ([Source (⭐2.1k)](https://github.com/LinwoodDev/Butterfly))
*   [Feather](https://openappscout.com/apps/feather/) - Install and manage apps on iPhone and iPad on the device, signed with your Apple Developer certificate. ([Source (⭐4.8k)](https://github.com/claration/Feather))
*   [Habo](https://openappscout.com/apps/habo/) - A minimalist habit tracker for iOS and Android that keeps your data on the phone, with optional encrypted sync. ([Source (⭐1.5k)](https://github.com/xpavle00/Habo))
*   [Humla](https://openappscout.com/apps/humla/) - AI meeting notes for Apple Silicon Macs that record calls with no bot and label speakers offline. ([Source (⭐304)](https://github.com/michaelwilhelmsen/humla))
*   [Joplin](https://openappscout.com/apps/joplin/) - Encrypted notes and to-dos on desktop and phone, synced through Joplin Cloud, Nextcloud, Dropbox or WebDAV. ([Source (⭐57k)](https://github.com/laurent22/joplin))
*   [Karakeep](https://openappscout.com/apps/karakeep/) - Save links, notes, images and PDFs to your own server, tagged by AI and fully searchable. ([Source (⭐30k)](https://github.com/karakeep-app/karakeep))
*   [LibreTrack](https://openappscout.com/apps/libretrack/) - Track parcels on Android and Linux straight from carrier accounts, with no third-party service. ([Source (⭐371)](https://github.com/proninyaroslav/libretrack))
*   [Linkwarden](https://openappscout.com/apps/linkwarden/) - Save bookmarks with a full copy of each page on your own server, so links never rot. ([Source (⭐20k)](https://github.com/linkwarden/linkwarden))
*   [Loofah](https://openappscout.com/apps/loofah/) - Meeting notes for Mac, recorded and transcribed on your computer and saved as Markdown. ([Source (⭐8)](https://github.com/bart6114/loofah))
*   [Meetily](https://openappscout.com/apps/meetily/) - Local AI meeting assistant for Mac and Windows that transcribes live and summarises without a cloud service. ([Source (⭐32k)](https://github.com/Zackriya-Solutions/meetily))
*   [Memex](https://openappscout.com/apps/memex/) - Local-first AI journal for iOS and Android that turns text, photo and voice notes into a timeline. ([Source (⭐777)](https://github.com/memex-lab/memex))
*   [Notesnook](https://openappscout.com/apps/notesnook/) - End-to-end encrypted notes app and Evernote alternative for mobile, desktop and web. ([Source (⭐15k)](https://github.com/streetwriters/notesnook))
*   [Orbit by Noveum](https://openappscout.com/apps/orbit/) - Free realtime task manager for issues, boards, sprints and docs, with an MCP endpoint for AI agents. ([Source (⭐64)](https://github.com/Noveum/orbit))
*   [Taskuary](https://openappscout.com/apps/taskuary/) - A local AI work inbox that gathers email and chat, drafts replies and waits for your approval. ([Source (⭐138)](https://github.com/ldbumble/taskuary))
*   [Weiyu](https://openappscout.com/apps/weiyu/) - A Windows app that turns your WeChat messages into searchable daily briefings, stored locally. ([Source (⭐33)](https://github.com/Sutera-Diffusus/WeChat-daily))

### Finance

*   [BeeCount](https://openappscout.com/apps/beecount/) - A private expense tracker for iOS and Android with multiple ledgers, AI receipt capture and self-hosted sync. ([Source (⭐2.5k)](https://github.com/TNT-Likely/BeeCount))
*   [BlueWallet](https://openappscout.com/apps/bluewallet/) - A privacy-focused Bitcoin and Lightning wallet for iOS and Android, with hardware-wallet support. ([Source (⭐3.3k)](https://github.com/BlueWallet/BlueWallet))
*   [MarketMonk](https://openappscout.com/apps/marketmonk/) - Track stocks and your portfolio with Yahoo Finance charts, keeping your trades on your device. ([Source (⭐64)](https://github.com/brandonp2412/MarketMonk))
*   [MetaMask Mobile](https://openappscout.com/apps/metamask-mobile/) - Official MetaMask self-custodial crypto wallet for iOS and Android, with a built-in browser for Ethereum apps. ([Source (⭐3.1k)](https://github.com/MetaMask/metamask-mobile))
*   [Monekin](https://openappscout.com/apps/monekin/) - Offline, ad-free money manager for Android and Windows with budgets, goals and 50+ currencies. ([Source (⭐258)](https://github.com/enrique-lozano/Monekin))
*   [Rainbow](https://openappscout.com/apps/rainbow/) - Ethereum wallet for iOS and Android with built-in swaps, an NFT gallery and a browser for crypto apps. ([Source (⭐4.4k)](https://github.com/rainbow-me/rainbow))

### Education

*   [Mathematics](https://openappscout.com/apps/mathematics/) - Generate math question papers and multiple-choice PDFs with answer keys, plus a quiz mode. ([Source (⭐143)](https://github.com/j-j-gajjar/mathematics/))
*   [Unwrap](https://openappscout.com/apps/unwrap/) - An iPhone app for learning Swift with video lessons, practice activities and daily challenges. ([Source (⭐2.3k)](https://github.com/twostraws/Unwrap))

### Tools

*   [Airdash](https://openappscout.com/apps/airdash/) - Send photos and files of any size between your phone and computer, encrypted, from anywhere. ([Source (⭐669)](https://github.com/simonbengtsson/airdash))
*   [AltStore](https://openappscout.com/apps/altstore/) - Install apps on iPhone and iPad without a jailbreak, signed with your own Apple ID. ([Source (⭐15k)](https://github.com/altstoreio/AltStore))
*   [BikeShare](https://openappscout.com/apps/bikeshare/) - Browse bike-share networks and stations from the CityBikes API on iOS, Android, desktop and web. ([Source (⭐828)](https://github.com/joreilly/BikeShare))
*   [Blink Comparison](https://openappscout.com/apps/blink-comparison/) - Check tamper-evident seals on Android by flicking between a reference photo and a new one. ([Source (⭐302)](https://github.com/proninyaroslav/blink-comparison))
*   [Cap](https://openappscout.com/apps/cap/) - Record your screen, mic and camera and share a link that plays in any browser, like Loom. ([Source (⭐23k)](https://github.com/CapSoftware/Cap))
*   [Ejimo](https://openappscout.com/apps/ejimo/) - Search and copy from 1,800+ emoji and 17,000+ symbols on desktop and mobile, offline. ([Source (⭐59)](https://github.com/albemala/emoji-picker))
*   [Helm](https://openappscout.com/apps/helm/) - Fifteen Mac monitoring and cleanup tools in one window, from storage and hardware stats to clipboard history. ([Source (⭐3)](https://github.com/devShakib015/helm))
*   [MangoDisk](https://openappscout.com/apps/mangodisk/) - Find what fills your disk on Mac and Windows and review every file before it is removed. ([Source (⭐4.3k)](https://github.com/harry0703/MangoDisk))
*   [NO SUS](https://openappscout.com/apps/no-sus/) - Student privacy toolkit to open files on a borrowed PC via phone QR and send self-destructing notes. ([Source](https://github.com/https-shubhamsahu/NON_SUS))
*   [PeopleInSpace](https://openappscout.com/apps/peopleinspace/) - Sample app showing who is in space and where the ISS is, a Kotlin Multiplatform reference for developers. ([Source (⭐3.4k)](https://github.com/joreilly/PeopleInSpace))
*   [Shieldxy](https://openappscout.com/apps/shieldxy/) - A Mac firewall and connection monitor that shows which apps connect where and lets you block them. ([Source (⭐3)](https://github.com/RockxyApp/Shieldxy))
*   [SubnetDesk](https://openappscout.com/apps/subnetdesk/) - Remote desktop for computers on the same LAN or VPN, with direct connections and no cloud account. ([Source (⭐700)](https://github.com/zibo-chen/SubnetDesk))
*   [UTM](https://openappscout.com/apps/utm/) - Run Windows, Linux and retro operating systems as virtual machines on Mac, iPhone and iPad. ([Source (⭐36k)](https://github.com/utmapp/UTM))

### Developer Tools

*   [Codex Quota Overlay](https://openappscout.com/apps/codex-quota-overlay/) - A Windows companion for Codex Desktop that displays quota and reset timing beside the conversation title. ([Source (⭐4)](https://github.com/cpys/codex-quota-overlay))
*   [Cortex](https://openappscout.com/apps/cortex-docs/) - A command-line tool that turns API specs and Markdown into docs sites, typed SDKs and MCP servers. ([Source (⭐3.3k)](https://github.com/cortex-docs/cortex))
*   [d1v.ai Mobile](https://openappscout.com/apps/d1vai-app/) - Create projects, continue AI coding sessions and watch deploys for d1v.ai from iOS or Android. ([Source (⭐9)](https://github.com/d1vai/d1vai_app))
*   [GitUp](https://openappscout.com/apps/gitup/) - A fast Git client for Mac where you edit history directly on a live commit graph. ([Source (⭐12k)](https://github.com/git-up/GitUp))
*   [Harbour](https://openappscout.com/apps/harbour/) - Manage Docker containers and stacks from iPhone, iPad and Mac through your Portainer server. ([Source (⭐764)](https://github.com/rrroyal/Harbour))
*   [HorizonCalendar](https://openappscout.com/apps/horizoncalendar/) - Airbnb's iOS calendar component, from simple date pickers to full month and week calendars. ([Source (⭐3.2k)](https://github.com/airbnb/HorizonCalendar))
*   [LoopTroop](https://openappscout.com/apps/looptroop/) - Run AI coding agents in parallel on your repo, compare their plans and approve each pull request. ([Source (⭐161)](https://github.com/looptroop-ai/LoopTroop))
*   [OpenDesign](https://openappscout.com/apps/open-design/) - AI design app that turns your coding agent into a designer for prototypes, decks, PDFs and videos. ([Source (⭐101k)](https://github.com/nexu-io/open-design))
*   [QuotaTempo](https://openappscout.com/apps/quotatempo/) - Mac menu-bar app that shows your weekly Codex and Claude quota left against an even-use pace. ([Source (⭐1)](https://github.com/Ishikawa-Hidekazu/quota-tempo))
*   [Rockxy](https://openappscout.com/apps/rockxy/) - A Mac app that captures and inspects HTTP and HTTPS traffic so developers can debug and mock API calls. ([Source (⭐1.4k)](https://github.com/RockxyApp/Rockxy))
*   [SwiftHub](https://openappscout.com/apps/swifthub/) - A GitHub app for iPhone to browse repositories, issues, pull requests and users. ([Source (⭐3.1k)](https://github.com/khoren93/SwiftHub))
*   [SwiftTerm](https://openappscout.com/apps/swiftterm/) - A Swift terminal emulator library for adding an Xterm/VT100 terminal to iOS and macOS apps. ([Source (⭐1.7k)](https://github.com/migueldeicaza/SwiftTerm))
*   [Tracexy](https://openappscout.com/apps/tracexy/) - A Mac app that captures live network traffic and opens PCAP files for analysis, all locally. ([Source (⭐220)](https://github.com/RockxyApp/Tracexy))
*   [Tura](https://openappscout.com/apps/tura/) - A coding agent for desktop and terminal built to finish tasks in fewer tokens and model turns. ([Source (⭐662)](https://github.com/Tura-AI/tura))

### Communication

*   [Berty](https://openappscout.com/apps/berty/) - An encrypted peer-to-peer messenger for iOS and Android that works without a server or internet. ([Source (⭐9.3k)](https://github.com/berty/berty))
*   [Keybase](https://openappscout.com/apps/keybase/) - Encrypted chat and file sharing tied to identities you prove on your public social accounts. ([Source (⭐9.3k)](https://github.com/keybase/client))
*   [Mattermost Mobile](https://openappscout.com/apps/mattermost-mobile/) - Official Mattermost team chat app for iOS and Android, with channels, threads, calls and push notifications. ([Source (⭐2.7k)](https://github.com/mattermost/mattermost-mobile))
*   [Rocket.Chat](https://openappscout.com/apps/rocket-chat-react-native/) - Rocket.Chat's official team chat app for iOS and Android, with channels, threads, calls and file sharing. ([Source (⭐2.4k)](https://github.com/RocketChat/Rocket.Chat.ReactNative))

### Health and Fitness

*   [Open Food Facts](https://openappscout.com/apps/open-food-facts/) - Scan food barcodes on Android and iOS to see ingredients and nutrition, and add products to the open database. ([Source (⭐1.4k)](https://github.com/openfoodfacts/smooth-app))
*   [wger](https://openappscout.com/apps/wger/) - A workout tracker for Android and iOS that syncs routines, exercises and progress with your wger server. ([Source (⭐981)](https://github.com/wger-project/flutter))

### Business

*   [Invoice Ninja](https://openappscout.com/apps/invoice-ninja/) - Send invoices, track expenses and time, and take payments from phone or desktop with Invoice Ninja. ([Source (⭐1.8k)](https://github.com/invoiceninja/flutter-mobile))

### About this project

    frontmatter and its review notes underneath. The schema and field
    ownership rules are documented in [docs/SCHEMA.md](https://github.com/tortuvshin/open-apps/blob/main/README.md/docs/SCHEMA.md).
*   The site is built with [Grove](https://withgrove.dev) on
    [Astro](https://astro.build) and Tailwind CSS, and deploys as a static
    site to Cloudflare.

### Add or update an app

*   Run `pnpm exec grove check` and `pnpm build`.

### Automation

*   **Every push and pull request** — CI runs an icon drift check,
    `grove check`, and a full site build.
*   **Weekly** — GitHub metadata sync, contributor sync, and README
    regeneration, each landing as a reviewable pull request.
*   **Monthly** — a cleanup report flags stale records for curator review;
    nothing is removed automatically.
